window_rule: Earliest non-setup HTTP completion minus http_req_duration to last non-setup HTTP completion. Duration excludes blocked/connect/TLS;100ms process samples interpolated,10ms CPU ticks.
notes: Counter rate intervals use callback boundaries, which differ slightly from internal interval endpoints. This check is not a phase uncertainty bound.
Exact allocation-byte totals are not inferred from unvalidated process allocation counters.
Original TestQuery oracle checks response structure once per VU; focused controls compare complete captured data once per VU. Every iteration checks HTTP status and absence of GraphQL errors.
Parent monitor is pinned to0,8 but is not individually sampled; aggregate systemCPU and countersCPU do not independently establish parent headroom.
No per-core samples exist; aggregate assigned-core headroom cannot exclude brief single-core stalls.
Ordinary fixed-rate drop invalidates that workload control even with complete successful response consistency.
scope: Retained shared baseline only; no candidate comparisons exist

iteration_boundaries.semantics: Native iteration_duration completion callback minus its duration; inferred iteration starts, not exact executor scheduling deadlines.
